sessionStats.ruleText: [session pattern] in recent Honu sessions (≥ 100 kills counted): assists per kill ≤ 0.1, headshot share ≥ 50% (headshot XP per kill; Census lifetime HSR when no XP detail) and K/D ≥ 7 (session deaths; Census lifetime KD when none). A very one-sided record; a lead for manual review, not proof.

metrics.label: Assists / kill
metrics.tip: Kill assists per kill in recent sessions (cheaters rarely share kills)

metrics.label: Assist dmg share
metrics.tip: Average damage share of an assist (from assist XP ÷ kill XP)

metrics.label: Session KPM
metrics.tip: Kills per minute over all counted sessions

metrics.label: Best-session KPM
metrics.tip: Highest KPM of one session (≥ 10 min, ≥ 20 kills)

metrics.label: KPM spread (CV)
metrics.tip: Std-dev ÷ mean of per-session KPM (how uneven sessions are)

metrics.label: Session K/D
metrics.tip: Kills ÷ deaths in counted sessions (deaths = kill events on the player)

metrics.label: Best-session K/D
metrics.tip: Highest K/D of one session (same minimum as best KPM; deaths floored at 1)

metrics.label: Kill-streak / kill
metrics.tip: Kill Streak XP events per kill (share of kills made while on a streak)

metrics.label: Revenge ÷ domination
metrics.tip: Revenge kills per domination kill (low = dominates, rarely needs revenge)

metrics.label: Savior / kill
metrics.tip: Savior kills (saving a teammate) per kill

metrics.label: Priority / kill
metrics.tip: Priority + high-priority kills per kill (bounty / streak targets)

metrics.label: Streak stops / kill
metrics.tip: Stop Kill Streak events per kill

hut.rule: 🛖 safe-spot damping, gradual, all cuts from this build's players. a = (🏃 Activity ÷ cut)², cut = median × (1.333 + (8 − 1.333) × ⚔️ iVi percentile ÷ 100 × e), a straight line, where e = experience 0 → 1 on estimated play time (lifetime kills ÷ lifetime KPM) from p5 to p25 of this build's players (new accounts stay near ×1.333), so weaker players get a lower cut and the top of the board up to ×8 (Activity at or above the cut → no change). w = product of three 0–1 ramps: deaths/min (KPM ÷ K/D) 1 at p10 → 0 at p20; 🪖 infantry 0 at 75% → 1 at 85%; accuracy 1 at the median → 0 at p60. A positive 🔀 Diff × (1 − w × (1 − a)), rounded; a negative Diff is untouched. 🛖 next to the name only when Diff drops by 10+ points. Owner override: "hut": "cleared" on the data/reviewed.json entry (no 🛖, no damping).

vehDiff.rule: 🔀 Diff vehicle damp, gradual, start from this build's players: start = median 🪖 vehicle share (15.0%). Vehicle share at or below the start → no change; above → factor = (100 − vehicle %) ÷ (100 − start), so only the on-foot part of a positive Diff counts (all-vehicle → 0). Negative Diff untouched. ⚔️ iVi already carries the 🚜 cut; this one keeps the Diff comparison about infantry. With 🛖 the lower factor applies (never both multiplied). Diff before = with 🛖 only. No mark next to the name; the Diff hover says “🚜 Reduced from …”. Owner override: "vehDiff": "cleared" on the data/reviewed.json player entry, or the 🚜 "vehicleCutCleared" exemption.

zergRevive.rule: 🪳 Zerg crowd check, from Honu XP detail (data/xp, players looked up or discovered; 50+ deaths by enemy players and 2+ h of play there, no kill minimum). Per death we count what the player RECEIVED: revives (Revive + Squad Revive), heals, shield repairs and resupplies (each + its squad version). rvp = the revived share's percentile among the 1318 measured players of this build (revived share p25 19.5%, median 29.7%, p75 44.6%). Crowd score = mean of the four percentiles; engineers with Hardlight barrier blocking XP (id 1393, only ticks inside a big crowd) at 0.02+ events/min get max(crowd, 0.8 × crowd + 0.2 × their Hardlight percentile) — it can only add (54 players). crp = the crowd score's percentile again among the same players. rvp ≥ 75 OR crp ≥ 75 → Zerg confirmed (unchanged, said on hover; 94 confirmed by the crowd score alone). Softening uses the HIGHER of rvp and crp (check): w = 1 at/below p25 → 0 at/above p50, Zerg = raw − round(w × max(0, raw − check)); never raised. No XP detail → unchanged. Estimated 🪳 (no Zerg score, e.g. few kills or assists): max(rvp, crp) when ≥ 75, shown as "~N" — display only, never sorted, pooled or marked (39 players). Listed: every softened player, confirmed ones with raw Zerg ≥ 67, and the estimates. Owner override: "zerg": "cleared" on the data/reviewed.json player entry (no crowd result at all; also left out of the pools).

newbieDiff.rule: 🐣 Newbie softening of a negative 🔀 Diff, gradual, ends from this build's 15563 players with a play time (lifetime kills ÷ lifetime KPM, the 🛖 estimate): lo = p5 (5.7 h), hi = p50 = the median (354.7 h). factor = 0 at/below lo, ln(h ÷ lo) ÷ ln(hi ÷ lo) between (log scale: the Impostor share drops by about the same step per doubling of play time), 1 at/above hi. Negative Diff × factor, rounded; positive Diff untouched; no play time → no change. 🐣 next to the name when the softening raised the Diff by 10+ points (hover “Softened from …”), and for every new player: play time below p14.000000000000002 (17.2 h, the end of the flat ~29% Impostor share at the start), whatever the Diff (hover “New player (about N h played)”). 🪦 inactive (no activity for over a year) wins: no 🐣 mark, the softened Diff stays. Owner override: "newbieDiff": "cleared" on the data/reviewed.json player entry (full negative Diff).

tractorMark.rule: 🚜 = infantry % < p25 (71.8%) and (vehicle repair/min ≥ p75 (0.924) or vehicle kills/min ≥ p75 (0.215) of the 1544 players with 2+ h of XP detail), or infantry % < p2 (21.5%)
